play.definition: A speed-sweep action where a motion man (typically a receiver) takes a handoff or pitch from the QB and attacks the edge in a zone-blocking scheme.

Action_BallCarry.label: Ball Carry
Action_BallCarry.definition: Any action by an offensive player who has possession of the football and is attempting to advance it downfield, including running, scrambling after a reception, or after a fumble recovery.

Action_BlockSecondLevel.label: Block Second Level
Action_BlockSecondLevel.definition: An offensive player engaging a defender who is past the initial line of scrimmage, typically a linebacker or safety, to create a running lane or protect the passer. This block occurs after the first wave of defensive linemen.

Action_ComboBlock.label: Combo Block
Action_ComboBlock.definition: An offensive line blocking technique where two offensive linemen initially double-team a defensive lineman (first-level defender) to create movement, and then one of the linemen disengages to 'climb' and block a second-level defender (linebacker or safety).

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.
